title: At the Post Office
objectives: Send letters and packages at the post office
Understand different mailing options and prices
Ask about delivery times and tracking
Fill out customs forms for international mail
target_phrases: I need to send this package
How much does it cost to mail this?
How long will it take to arrive?
I'd like to send this priority mail
Do I need a customs form?
What's the fastest way to send this?

dialogue.title: Sending a Package Home
dialogue.context: Ahmed needs to send a package to his family in Somalia. He goes to the post office and talks to the clerk.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Good morning! How can I help you today?

lines.speaker: Ahmed
lines.text: Hi. I need to send this package to Somalia. What's the best way to do that?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Let me weigh it first. Okay, it's 3 pounds. You have three options: First Class International takes 2-3 weeks and costs $45. Priority Mail International takes 6-10 days and costs $75. Or Express Mail arrives in 3-5 days but costs $120.

lines.speaker: Ahmed
lines.text: How long will it take to arrive with Priority Mail?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Usually 6 to 10 business days. It also comes with tracking so you can see where it is.

lines.speaker: Ahmed
lines.text: That sounds good. Can I track the package online?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Yes, I'll give you a tracking number. You can check it on usps.com.

lines.speaker: Ahmed
lines.text: Perfect. Do I need to fill out any forms?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Yes, you need a customs form. Write down what's inside and the value. What's in the package?

lines.speaker: Ahmed
lines.text: Just clothes and some gifts for my family. The value is about $50.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Great. Fill out this form and sign here. Your total is $75. How would you like to pay?

lines.speaker: Ahmed
lines.text: I'll pay with my debit card. Thank you for your help!

listening_exercises.transcript: Welcome to the post office. We offer several mailing services. First Class Mail is our standard service for letters and small packages within the U.S. - it takes 2-5 days. Priority Mail is faster, arriving in 1-3 days, and includes tracking. Priority Mail Express is our fastest option - overnight or 2-day delivery with a money-back guarantee.
listening_exercises.question: How long does First Class Mail take?

listening_exercises.transcript: For international mail, you must fill out a customs form. List all items in the package and their value. Be honest - customs will inspect packages. Don't send prohibited items like perfume, batteries, or food. Maximum value for gifts is $100 to avoid customs fees in many countries.
listening_exercises.question: What should you NOT send internationally?

listening_exercises.transcript: You can track your package online at usps.com. Enter your tracking number to see exactly where your package is. You'll get updates when it's accepted, in transit, out for delivery, and delivered. You can also sign up for text or email notifications.
listening_exercises.question: How can you track your package?
options: Check usps.com with your tracking number
Go to the post office in person

speaking_tasks.prompt: You're at the post office. Record yourself saying: 'I need to send this package to [country]. How much does it cost? How long will it take?' Use a clear, polite voice.
speaking_tasks.example: Hello, I need to send this package to Somalia. It's not very heavy - maybe 2 or 3 pounds. How much does it cost to send it? And how long will it take to arrive? I want to make sure it gets there safely. Thank you.

speaking_tasks.prompt: Explain to a friend how to send a package at the post office. Give 3 steps. Record for at least 30 seconds.
speaking_tasks.example: Sending a package is easy. First, pack your items carefully in a box. Second, go to the post office and tell them where you're sending it. They'll weigh it and tell you the cost and delivery time. Third, fill out the address clearly and any customs forms if it's international. Don't forget to get a tracking number so you can see where your package is!

writing_tasks.prompt: Write 5 sentences about why you might need to use the post office. Use phrases like: 'I need to...', 'The post office helps me...', 'I can...'
writing_tasks.example: I need to send packages to my family in Somalia. The post office helps me mail things safely and track them. I can send letters, packages, and important documents. Sometimes I need to buy stamps for birthday cards. The post office also has P.O. boxes where I can receive mail.

writing_tasks.prompt: You're filling out a customs form. Describe what's in your package in 3-4 sentences. Include: what items are inside, their value, and who they're for.
writing_tasks.example: This package contains clothes, books, and toys for my children. The clothes are worth about $30, the books are $15, and the toys are $10. The total value is $55. These are personal gifts for my family, not for sale.

grammar_focus.title: Future Time with 'will'
grammar_focus.explanation: Use 'will' to talk about future delivery and arrival times.
examples: It will arrive in 3 days. (future)
The package will cost $75. (future)
They will deliver it tomorrow. (future)
I will send it today. (future)

grammar_focus.title: Questions with 'How much' and 'How long'
grammar_focus.explanation: 'How much' asks about price or amount. 'How long' asks about time duration.
examples: How much does it cost? (price)
How long will it take? (time)
How much does this weigh? (amount)
How long is the delivery time? (duration)

grammar_focus.title: Comparative Mailing Options
grammar_focus.explanation: Use comparatives to compare different mailing speeds and prices.
examples: Priority Mail is faster than First Class. (speed)
Express Mail is more expensive than Priority. (price)
This option is cheaper but slower. (comparison)
International mail takes longer than domestic. (time)

cultural_notes: USPS (United States Postal Service) is the government-run mail service. UPS and FedEx are private companies.
Most post offices are open Monday-Friday 9 AM to 5 PM, and Saturday 9 AM to noon. Closed Sundays.
You can buy stamps online, at grocery stores, or from vending machines at the post office.
Flat Rate boxes from USPS let you ship anything that fits for one price, regardless of weight.
Media Mail is a cheap option for shipping books and educational materials.
International packages can take 2-8 weeks depending on the destination country.
Always save your receipt and tracking number until the package is delivered.

speaking.instruction: Waxaad joogtaa xafiiska boostada. Duub codkaaga adigoo dhihi: 'I need to send this package to [country]. How much does it cost? How long will it take?' U adeegso cod cad oo edeb leh.
U sharax saaxiibkaa sida loo diro baqshad xafiiska boostada. Bixi saddex tallaabo. Duub ugu yaraan 30 ilbiriqsi.

writing.instruction: Qor 5 jumlado oo ku saabsan sababta aad u baahan karto inaad isticmaasho boostada. Isticmaal weedho sida: 'I need to...', 'The post office helps me...', 'I can...'
Waxaad buuxinaysaa foomka boostada. Ku qor 3-4 jumlado waxa ku jira baqshaddaada. Ku dar: alaabta ku jirta, qiimaha, iyo cidda loogu talagalay.

sections.explanation: 'How much' waxay weydiisaa qiimaha ama inta. 'How long' waxay weydiisaa muddada.
